name: A Forbidden Path Reduction Forces Every Contraction USO to Fork
statement: If an ample pc-minimal obstruction to dismantlable ampleness has a reduction $D=\{u,c,v\}$ inducing the path $u-c-v$, every acyclic USO of its contraction directs both path edges away from $c$. Equivalently, every corner peeling of the contraction deletes $c$ before both endpoints.
proof: The contraction is corner-peelable. On a three-vertex path the only orientation violating the outgoing-cube condition is the fork with source at its middle vertex. Every other induced orientation is a USO of the reduction and would lift by the horizontal-lift criterion, contradicting nonpeelability of the expansion. The peeling–acyclic-USO correspondence translates the orientation statement into deletion order.
